name: Mobility Global, Inc.
summary: Mobility Global, Inc. provides automotive data, insights, and technology solutions in the United States and internationally. It operates in two segments, CARFAX and Business-to-Business (B2B). The CARFAX segment provides consumers, dealers, car service providers, and finance and insurance with vehicle history, valuations, listings, and service reminders through proprietary data estate and brand to help consumers buy the right car at the right price, sell, and maintain vehicles.
